description: Valid hook configuration for Claude Code

eventHandlerSupport.description: Which handler types each event accepts. Every event accepts command and mcp_tool; the groups below differ only in whether http, prompt and agent are also accepted.
eventHandlerSupport.note: mcp_tool hooks require the named MCP server to be already connected. SessionStart and Setup usually fire before servers finish connecting, so an mcp_tool hook there gets a non-blocking 'not connected' error on first run.

if.description: Permission rule syntax filter. Only runs the hook when the tool/event matches this pattern (e.g. 'Bash(git *)').

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds. Defaults: command/http/mcp_tool=600, prompt=30, agent=60. Lowered to 30 on UserPromptSubmit, PreModelSwitch and PostModelSwitch, and to 10 on MessageDisplay. SessionEnd hooks share a 1.5s budget.

statusMessage.description: Custom spinner message shown while the hook runs

once.description: If true, runs only once per session then removed (skills only)

async.description: Run hook in background without blocking Claude. Only for command type.

shell.description: Shell to use. Accepts 'bash' (default) or 'powershell' (Windows). Requires CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL=1 for PowerShell.

url.description: URL to send POST request to

headers.description: HTTP headers with env var interpolation ($VAR or ${VAR})

allowedEnvVars.description: Environment variable names allowed in headers

server.description: Name of an already-connected MCP server. For a plugin-bundled server use the scoped name plugin:<plugin-name>:<server-name>. The hook never triggers an OAuth or connection flow.

tool.description: Name of the tool to call on that server

input.description: Arguments passed to the tool. String values support ${path} substitution from the hook input, e.g. "${tool_input.file_path}".

prompt.description: Text prompt for single-turn LLM evaluation. Use $ARGUMENTS for hook input JSON

model.description: Model to use for evaluation (default: fast model)

prompt.description: Text prompt for multi-turn agent verification. Use $ARGUMENTS for hook input JSON

model.description: Model to use for the agent (default: fast model)

PreModelSwitch.description: Before Claude Code applies a model switch you or a client requested (v2.1.251+). Does NOT fire for switches Claude Code makes on its own.
PreModelSwitch.note: Matcher is the canonical name of the target model, ignoring any [1m] suffix; every alias and dated or provider-specific ID resolves to it. When no canonical name can be derived, every hook runs regardless of matcher — check to_model in the input. Exit 2 or hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision (allow/deny/ask) controls the switch; a timeout blocks it. Default timeout 30s.

PostModelSwitch.description: After the session model changed, including automatic fallback, opusplan entering/leaving plan mode, and model restore on resume (v2.1.251+)
PostModelSwitch.note: Same matcher rules as PreModelSwitch. Cannot block. Stdout or hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext is delivered to Claude with the next request. Input adds source values auto and resume. Default timeout 30s.

UserPromptSubmit.note: Matcher is ignored for this event

Stop.note: Matcher is ignored for this event

TeammateIdle.description: Agent team teammate about to go idle
TeammateIdle.note: No matcher support. Exit 2 only (no hookSpecificOutput support)

TaskCompleted.note: No matcher support. Exit 2 only (no hookSpecificOutput support)

ConfigChange.note: Matcher is the config type that changed

InstructionsLoaded.description: When CLAUDE.md or .claude/rules/*.md file is loaded
InstructionsLoaded.note: Matcher is the load reason. Exit code is ignored.

WorktreeCreate.description: When a worktree is being created
WorktreeCreate.note: No matcher support. Any non-zero exit fails worktree creation. Hook prints absolute path to worktree on stdout.

WorktreeRemove.description: When a worktree is being removed
WorktreeRemove.note: No matcher support. Receives worktree_path in input. Logged in debug mode only.

Elicitation.description: When an MCP server requests user input during a tool call
Elicitation.note: Matcher is the MCP server name (regex). Exit 2 denies elicitation.

ElicitationResult.description: After a user responds to an MCP elicitation
ElicitationResult.note: Matcher is the MCP server name (regex). Exit 2 blocks response.

TaskCreated.description: When a task is being created via TaskCreate
TaskCreated.note: No matcher support. Exit 2 prevents the task from being created.

StopFailure.description: When the turn ends due to an API error. Output and exit code are ignored.
StopFailure.note: Matcher is the error type. No decision control — output and exit code are ignored.

CwdChanged.description: When the working directory changes (e.g. cd command). Useful for direnv.
CwdChanged.note: No matcher support. Non-blocking — stderr shown to user only.

DirectoryAdded.description: When a working directory is added mid-session via /add-dir or the SDK register_repo_root control request
DirectoryAdded.note: Matcher is how the directory was added. Does NOT fire for --add-dir at startup (SessionStart covers those) or for the /permissions Workspace tab. Runs in the background after the add completes — no decision control, and the continue field is discarded. Input adds directory and source.

FileChanged.description: When a watched file changes on disk. Matcher specifies filenames to watch.
FileChanged.note: Matcher is the filename (basename). Non-blocking — stderr shown to user only.

PermissionDenied.description: When the user denies a permission request
PermissionDenied.note: Matcher is the tool name. Non-blocking — informational only.

PostToolBatch.description: After full batch of parallel tool calls resolves, before next model call
PostToolBatch.note: No matcher support. Receives tool_calls array in input. Can block next model call or add context.

UserPromptExpansion.description: When a user-typed slash command expands into a prompt (before reaching Claude)
UserPromptExpansion.note: Matcher is the command name. Can block expansion or add context. Input includes expansion_type, command_name, command_args, command_source, prompt.

Setup.description: Fires only with --init-only, or --init/--maintenance in -p mode. For one-time dependency installation or scheduled cleanup.
Setup.note: Matcher is the CLI flag that triggered the hook. Only command type supported. Cannot block — exit 2 shows stderr but continues. Has access to CLAUDE_ENV_FILE for persisting env vars.

MessageDisplay.description: Fires while assistant message text streams to the user (display-only, observational)
MessageDisplay.note: No matcher support — fires on every message display. Non-blocking (exit 2 shows stderr only). Can replace the shown text via hookSpecificOutput.displayContent (display only — does NOT change the transcript or Claude's context). Input includes message_text and message_id. Timeout defaults to 10s (shorter than other events).

updatedInput.description: PreToolUse hooks can modify tool inputs before execution
updatedInput.usage: Return JSON with hookSpecificOutput.updatedInput to rewrite tool arguments

permissionDecision.description: PermissionRequest hooks can control permission decisions
permissionDecision.usage: Return hookSpecificOutput.decision with behavior (allow/deny), updatedInput, updatedPermissions, message

updatedMCPToolOutput.description: PostToolUse hooks can replace MCP tool output
updatedMCPToolOutput.usage: Return hookSpecificOutput.updatedMCPToolOutput to replace the tool's output (MCP tools only)

displayContent.description: MessageDisplay hooks can replace the text shown to the user (display only — not the transcript or Claude's context)
displayContent.usage: Return hookSpecificOutput.displayContent with the replacement text

topLevelDecision.description: Several events support top-level decision/reason for blocking

elicitationAction.description: Elicitation hooks can control the action

universalFields.description: All events support these stdout JSON fields

fields.continue: If false, Claude stops entirely (takes precedence over event-specific fields)
fields.stopReason: Message shown to user when continue is false
fields.suppressOutput: If true, hides stdout from verbose mode

promptAgentResponse.description: Prompt and agent hook types return structured responses

exitCodes.2: Block the action (stderr becomes Claude's feedback)
exitCodes.other: Allow but log error (visible in verbose mode)

blocking.description: These events can be blocked with exit code 2

nonBlocking.description: Exit code 2 shows stderr but does not block
nonBlocking.note: WorktreeCreate: any non-zero exit fails creation. WorktreeRemove: logged in debug only. StopFailure: output and exit code are ignored entirely. DirectoryAdded: stderr goes to the debug log, the directory is already added.

hookInput.description: Hook commands receive a JSON object via stdin (NOT via environment variables). HTTP hooks receive the same JSON as POST body.

structure.permission_mode: Current permission mode (default, plan, acceptEdits, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions)
structure.hook_event_name: The event that triggered the hook (e.g. PostToolUse)
structure.tool_name: Name of the tool (for PreToolUse/PostToolUse events)
structure.tool_input: Object with the tool's input parameters (e.g. file_path, command)
structure.tool_response: Object with the tool's response (PostToolUse only)
structure.tool_use_id: Unique identifier for the tool invocation
structure.agent_id: Subagent ID (only when hook fires inside subagent call)
structure.agent_type: Agent name (only with --agent or inside subagent)
structure.directory: Absolute path of the added directory (DirectoryAdded only)
structure.source: How the event was triggered (DirectoryAdded: slash_command|register_repo_root; PreModelSwitch: command|picker|sdk; PostModelSwitch: also auto|resume)
structure.from_model: Model ID the switch changes from (Pre/PostModelSwitch only)
structure.to_model: Model ID the switch changes to — the matcher compares against its canonical name (Pre/PostModelSwitch only)

hookInput.note: CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT and TOOL_INPUT env vars are NOT set. Always read from stdin.

environmentVariables.description: These env vars are available but do NOT include tool input
environmentVariables.CLAUDE_ENV_FILE: File path for persisting environment variables (SessionStart hooks)
environmentVariables.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT: Root directory of the plugin (for referencing bundled scripts)
environmentVariables.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA: Directory for plugin persistent data (survives plugin updates)
environmentVariables.CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE: Set to 'true' when running in remote/web environments

invalidEvents.description: These event names DO NOT EXIST - never use them
